entities.summary: Samuel Mackinnon is an Australian basketball coach and former player who is currently head coach of the Southside Melbourne Flyers of the Women's National Basketball League (WNBL). He played in the National Basketball League (NBL) between 1994 and 2010, where he won two NBL championships and was named the NBL Most Valuable Player in 2007.
